posts.title: How to Make a DIY Sink Stand
posts.description: At some point in the process of refurbishing the concrete garage sink I decided to build a DIY sink stand for it. We had considered building a cabinet like our garage cabinets, but that didn’t feel right. We also knew it had to be sturdy enough to support the substantial weight of the concrete sink....
